This role combines hands-on development with leadership responsibilities, ensuring architectural integrity, security, and performance across the stack. The ideal candidate will lead technical initiatives, mentor team members, and collaborate with stakeholders to align technology solutions with business objectives. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership & Architecture Lead engineering teams by providing technical direction, architectural guidance, and design reviews. Define and drive application and integration architecture aligned with scalability, security, and enterprise standards. Act as the technical point of contact for complex solutions involving systems, tools, platforms, and AI-enabled components. Support cloud adoption, modernization, and re-architecture initiatives. Development & Code Stabilization Maintain strong involvement in development using Python and modern web application frameworks. Design, develop, and maintain web applications, backend services, and integration components. Own code stabilization efforts, including refactoring, performance tuning, and reduction of technical debt. Perform deep debugging, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex engineering issues. Apply optimization techniques to improve performance, scalability, and reliability. Integration, APIs & Security Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration services across applications and platforms. Implement and guide authentication and authorization mechanisms (token-based auth, OAuth, etc.). Ensure reliable system-to-system integrations across internal tools, cloud services, and AI platforms. Work closely with data and platform teams to ensure robust end-to-end flows. Cloud, Dev Ops & CI/CD Architect, deploy, and manage applications on AWS, leveraging appropriate cloud services. Drive cloud-native best practices, reliability, security, and cost optimization. Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Git-based workflows and AWS CI/CD services. Lead usage of Docker and container-based deployment strategies. Apply Dev Ops practices, including automation, monitoring, logging, and deployment strategies. AI & Emerging Technologies Evaluate and guide adoption of AI tools, Gen AI capabilities, and emerging technologies. Lead proof-of-concepts (Po Cs) and technical assessments for new tools, frameworks, and platforms. Provide recommendations on technology fit, scalability, and enterprise readiness. Team Leadership & Mentoring Lead, mentor, and coach engineers to build strong technical and problem-solving capabilities. Conduct code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Establish and enforce engineering standards, best practices, and quality guidelines. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence. What you will have Strong hands-on experience with Python and backend development. Proven experience building and supporting web applications. Strong experience with AWS cloud services and cloud adoption strategies. Expertise in system integration, APIs, and distributed architectures. Solid knowledge of REST APIs, authentication, and authorization mechanisms. Strong understanding of databases (relational and/or No SQL). Experience with Git, version control strategies, and CI/CD pipelines in AWS. Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized applications. Strong Dev Ops knowledge and experience implementing automation practices. Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and optimization skills. Proven ability to lead and mentor teams in enterprise environments. Work Timings: 01:00 Noon -10:00PM IST This position requires the employee to work a 5-day-a-week schedule in the office. Nice to Have Experience in large-scale enterprise integrations or cloud modernization programs. Exposure to monitoring, observability, and reliability engineering practices. Knowledge of security best practices in cloud and web development. Agile/Scrum experience. Prior experience in leading technical projects or teams. Experience working with AI / Gen AI tools and platforms. Database Design (Physical): Knowledge of database systems; ability to establish a data model for designing an organization's database that runs effectively and efficiently for better business outcome. Level Working Knowledge: • Researches relationships between different business data sets. • Participates in the establishment of data structures based on their relationships. • Adheres to an organization's database design policies. • Utilizes database design tools and techniques. • Tests the effectiveness of the database before its release for business use. ETL Process: Knowledge of the extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) process; ability to develop a database through the ETL process. Level Working Knowledge: • Ensures the accuracy and effectiveness of data provided for the warehouse. • Loads selected data into the warehouse on a regular basis. • Derives necessary business or technical information from original data. • Acquires a large amount of data from different sources/systems. • Solves technical and administrative problems during the ETL process. Modeling: Data, Process, Events, Objects: Knowledge of data, process and events; ability to use tools and techniques for analyzing and documenting logical relationships among data, processes or events. Level Working Knowledge: • Defines common types of data, processes or event models. • Participates in model reviews and walkthroughs. • Explains existing models to clients and describes their associated business processes. • Focuses on modifying Data Structure, Access and Entity Relationship Diagrams. • Prepares reports to recap current findings and issues in data, processes or event models. Role Definition To develop and maintain sales model product compatibility in the ERP based business process. ERP supports the worldwide sales of the Machines. This position is for an experienced, individual contributing on assignments that are complex and challenging and begin to become strategic in nature. Key responsibilities of this assignment are: Comply with standards developed by Technical Analyst for a product configuration in ERP. Develop/maintain sales model product compatibility in ERP System. Interact with Engineering personnel to ascertain accurate and clearly defined feature or part number compatibility. Interact with Pricing personnel to ensure the feature code assignment is accurate Meet regular schedules for introducing the product compatibility changes to External/internal users relying on configuration to meet their ordering needs. Provide timely response to Local Change Coordinators / Material Master Owners in coordinating changes resulting from Bill of Material synchronization and other engineering change notices. The position manages the completion of its own work assignments and coordinates work with others. Qualification: The position requires thorough, detailed knowledge of company products and product applications. A detailed understanding of ERP is essential. Must have analytical ability and initiative, be results oriented, and have strong written and verbal communication skills. Written and spoken fluency in English is a requirement, other languages are also an asset. Three months of training and on the job experience as a Product Configuration Analyst are typically required. The position typically requires a four-year college degree in Mechanical/Production/Manufacturing stream. Incumbent initiates communication with others outside the immediate work group to work on new ideas and counsel others. The ability to listen and guide others is critical to the success of this job. The incumbent must have multiple application experience or the equivalent work knowledge. Typical internal customers include various contacts throughout the Caterpillar worldwide and its subsidiaries. These contacts include Engineering, Product Group, Pricing, and NPI groups. - GFS Strategy -Global Finance Services Division. The incumbent would Lead data quality initiatives for Finance platforms by designing and operationalizing DQ rules, pipelines and remediation processes. Partner with stakeholders to ensure trusted, governed data for analytics and financial reporting. The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore-Shared Services What you will do Lead business and IT discussions for DQ solution development, enhancements and support Accountable and responsible for overall data accuracy and completeness for priority data elements Champion data governance framework and support data cataloging and glossary efforts Good with documentation and creating process maps – for example
- technical design documents, Requirement Docs, BRDs, Project Plan, Status Decks, etc. Good requirement-gathering skills and experience as a technical business analyst. Design, build and operate end-to-end data quality pipelines and validations to support reconciliation and data quality for finance datasets. Author, implement and monitor data quality rules and expectations Build and maintain data pipelines using Snowflake/Snowpark and/or AWS Glue (Crawlers, Jobs, Workflows, Glue Data Quality). Integrate Glue workflows with Apache Airflow for orchestration; develop Lambda functions for processing and orchestration tasks. Design and develop API integrations connecting AWS/Snowflake/Web UI etc. to support data quality solution Drive DQ remediation with data owners and stewards: automate fixes where safe, escalate and manage manual remediation Capture metadata, lineage and access controls; collaborate with governance and security teams. Produce technical documentation, requirement specs and DQ dashboards; mentor junior analysts. What you will have 8 + years’ experience in data management, data quality/governance or related roles. Strong hands-on experience with SQL and Python. Experience with Snowflake and/or AWS data stack (AWS Glue, Glue Data Catalog, Lambda, Athena). Proven experience authoring and operationalizing DQ rules and remediation processes. Strong stakeholder engagement, requirements-gathering and documentation skills. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience integrating Glue workflows with Apache Airflow. Experience with Alation or other data catalog tools. Certifications: AWS (Data Analytics or Solutions Architect), DAMA/DMBOK, or DQ certification. Experience with building dashboards or Web UI to support DQ dashboards Proficient in AI tools like Co-Pilot, Github Copilot, VS code, Snowflake Cortex etc. Core Skills & Competencies: Data profiling, cleansing, enrichment and DQ frameworks Pipeline orchestration and automation Troubleshooting, logging and observability best practices (Cloud Watch, monitoring tools) Version control (Git) and collaboration tools (Azure Devops) Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills Skills desired: Business Analysis: Knowledge of business analysis and the set of tasks, techniques and tools required to identify business needs; ability to recommend solutions that deliver value to stakeholders. Level Working Knowledge: • Analyzes the value of a business and its functions through the value estimation of assets. • Applies the prerequisites to a project before starting the business analysis process. • Collaborates with stakeholders, development teams, testing teams, etc., to deliver business solutions. • Documents the business case to justify the requirements of time and resources of a project. • Utilizes diverse analysis tools and methodologies to group different business activities based on shared characteristics or similarities. Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Level Extensive Experience: • Differentiates assumptions, perspectives, and historical frameworks. • Evaluates past decisions for insights to improve decision-making process. • Assesses and validates decision options and points and predicts their potential impact. • Advises others in analyzing and synthesizing relevant data and assessing alternatives. • Uses effective decision-making approaches such as consultative, command, or consensus. • Ensures that assumptions and received wisdom are objectively analyzed in decisions. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Extensive Experience: • Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching. • Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience. • Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position. • Communicates well downward, upward, and outward. • Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement. • Maintains focus on the topic at hand. Software Engineering: Knowledge of software engineering; ability to deliver new or enhanced fee-based software products. Level Working Knowledge: • Identifies considerations for product integration with multiple platforms and systems. • Works with development or delivery of a software package or component. • Describes phases, activities, deliverables and processes for a specific methodology. • Works with structured documents for developing features, functions, plans and schedules. • Describes software design practices, technologies, and considerations. Level Working Knowledge: • Documents resolution progress and provides feedback to customers. • Describes issues and consideration for resolving problems involving other products or vendors. • Works with tracking and resolving common types of problems for a product or product group. • Describes actions, tools, and procedures for problem reporting, solving, and resolution. • Cites examples of unusual problems; follows proper notifications and escalation procedures. title: Agile Facilitator
jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Role Definition Facilitate the operations of an Agile framework with 1-3 teams while embracing the principles of the framework and the Agile mindset. Help teams reach their highest performance level in the execution of workstreams. Responsibilities • Planning, scheduling, and facilitating Agile events. Fostering an environment of self-organization, high visibility, ownership, and continuous improvement with the team • Coaching the Agile team into an understanding of the values, artifacts, and objectives of the operating framework with a lean mindset • Working with the product owner/service request manager and stakeholders to ensure value is always being generated by the team's work. • Becoming a champion of removing blockers and impediments to the teams progress, while facilitating the reduction of decision latency with clear and constant communication and attention. Helping the team to capture and aggregate data useful to the team's development, as well as providing management information that will inform strategic decisions. Skill Descriptors Business Performance Management: Knowledge of technologies, techniques and practices for the use of business intelligence; ability to monitor and adjust business processes (internal and cross-organizational) in near real-time. Level Basic Understanding: • Cites examples of measurements of business performance. • Identifies organization's strengths and weaknesses. • Describes key aspects and benefits of Business Performance Management (BPM.) • Lists common types of resources tracked in a BPM environment. Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan. Level Basic Understanding: • Explains tactical plan for own area. • Defines concepts of short-term and long-term planning. • Describes the planning process and planning cycle used in own area. • Compares tactical to strategic planning. Growth and Agility: Knowledge of the necessity of businesses and individuals to experiment, learn continuously, and achieve value for the organization; ability to embrace challenges, show resilience, and proactively seek improvement and innovation to improve an organization's competitive advantage. Level Basic Understanding: • Knows how to access and use available learning and development resources. • Identifies and welcomes changes and ambiguities that arise in the business environment. • Asks questions and listens to and embraces feedback non-defensively for personal growth. • Collects necessary information, learning resources, and best practices used to resolve ambiguous situations. Collaborating: Knowledge of collaborative techniques; ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner. Level Working Knowledge: • Demonstrates experience participating in productive collaborative processes. • Under guidance, initiates collaborative meetings. • Assists in communicating shared goals with diverse groups and parties. • Helps promote collaboration across generations, functions, regions, and levels. • Helps solve business problems and meet business goals through collaborative processes. Group Facilitation: Knowledge of group facilitation best practices and ability to design and facilitate a group process, elicit contributions from group members, stimulate a focused group discussion, and achieve a desired outcome. Level Working Knowledge: • Describes common facilitation techniques and typical scenarios where each could be used. • Uses at least one formal facilitation method or technique to moderate a session. • Participates in the identification and selection of the most qualified candidates for the group. • Plans, coordinates and conducts facilitated sessions. • Clarifies and achieves agreement on the purpose and goals of the session. Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization. Level Basic Understanding: • Gives examples of decisions and who influenced whom in the decision. • Describes key concepts of influencing. • Documents and distributes suggestions and ideas, with supporting detail. • Identifies local key players and decision makers. Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers. Level Basic Understanding: • Provides examples of the characteristics of effective business relationships. • Identifies key business relationships in own organization. • Describes the nature of a productive business relationship. • Explains the benefits of building business partnerships. Agile Development: Knowledge of agile methodologies and the agile development lifecycle; ability to utilize formal agile methodologies, disciplines, practices and techniques for the delivery of new and enhanced applications. Level Working Knowledge: • Explains a specific agile process and its associated checkpoints and deliverables. • Works with a specific agile development methodology. • Interprets metrics used to measure progress and effectiveness. • Defines key selection and qualifying criteria for projects suitable for agile development. • Applies major tools and techniques associated with the specific methodology. - September 24, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community. title: Senior Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Role Definition Senior Data Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced AI/ML solutions that drive business impact. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in statistics, machine learning, large language models (LLMs), model evaluation, and Python-based solution development. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to develop scalable analytics and Generative AI solutions that improve decision-making, automation, and customer experiences. Responsibilities • Apply advanced statistical techniques to analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, identify insights, and quantify business impact. • Develop end-to-end ML and Gen AI pipelines, including data preparation, model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. • Build scalable Python-based solutions and reusable ML components that integrate with enterprise platforms and cloud environments. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business problems into analytical solutions and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. • Stay current with emerging AI, machine learning, and LLM advancements, driving innovation and adoption of best practices. Skill Descriptors Business Statistics: Knowledge of the statistical tools, processes, and practices to describe business results in measurable scales; ability to use statistical tools and processes to assist in making business decisions. Level Working Knowledge: • Explains the basic decision process associated with specific statistics. • Works with basic statistical functions on a spreadsheet or a calculator. • Explains reasons for common statistical errors, misinterpretations, and misrepresentations. • Describes characteristics of sample size, normal distributions, and standard deviation. • Generates and interprets basic statistical data. Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Extensive Experience: • Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices. • Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy. • Productively balances speed and accuracy. • Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals. • Implements a variety of cross-checking approaches and mechanisms. • Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards. Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Working Knowledge: • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance. • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions. • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns. • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand. • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions. Machine Learning: Knowledge of principles, technologies and algorithms of machine learning; ability to develop, implement and deliver related systems, products and services. Level Working Knowledge: • Completes specific tasks and initiatives utilizing machine learning technologies, such as search engine optimization. • Utilizes specific tools and techniques to process descriptive and inferential statistics. • Applies specific computing languages and tools in machine learning, such as R and Python. • Explores to use machine learning in one own areas to make business improvements. • Conducts data mining and cleaning initiatives. Programming Languages: Knowledge of basic concepts and capabilities of programming; ability to use tools, techniques and platforms in order to write and modify programming languages. Level Working Knowledge: • Participates in the implementation and support of specialized programming languages. • Conducts basic reviews on writing a specific programming language within a specific platform. • Assists with the design and development of specialized programming languages. • Follows an organization's standards, policies and guidelines for structured programming specifications. • Diagnoses and reports minor or routine programming language problems. Query and Database Access Tools: Knowledge of data management systems; ability to use, support and access facilities for searching, extracting and formatting data for further use. Level Extensive Experience: • Writes, debugs and implements complex queries involving multiple tables or databases. • Works with aggregate functions, complex joins, groupings, dynamic and embedded SQL's (Structured Query Languages). • Teaches others about query optimization techniques and facilities. • Consults on query optimization, interactive queries, testing and verification. • Evaluates all major database access tools and functions for distributed databases. • Compares and contrasts the benefits and drawbacks of various SQL products. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge: • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements. • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis. • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements. • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements. • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis. jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Job Summary: The primary objective of this role is to support the Product Support & Logistics (PSLD) division in achieving its inventory and customer service goals. As part of Inventory Management (IM) systems and process support, the position requires strong expertise in Materials Management, along with cross-functional collaboration with IT, Finance, Purchasing, and Warehouse Management teams. The role involves leading projects, conducting ad hoc analyses, and driving system and process improvements to enhance operational efficiency across Aftermarket Parts Distribution. What You Will Do: Lead SAP-SPM materials implementation starting from advanced preparation to Go-live and stabilization phases. Identify gaps, document functional requirements within IM processes. Business Process flows (PTP, OTC and TPOP) understanding. Responsible for providing Business and System support to IM processes Work closely with global teams in making process improvements and enhancements to IM system / processes. Must be open to learning the analytical techniques for Data Analysis, Inventory Management (IM) System Configuration/logic and statistically oriented analysis. Degree Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in engineering / Math’s / Science / Commerce. 4 to 6 years’ relevant experience in SAP MM Module or Service Parts Planning. SAS or SQL coding experience is preferred. What You Have: Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge: Communicates key considerations for business decision making process. Cites examples of types of information needed to make sound business decisions. Participates in business task to get things done in own unit or area. Caters to key stakeholders and their priorities. Inventory Management: Knowledge of processes and methods of inventory management; ability to effectively manage organization's materials, commodities, merchandises, or products. Level Extensive Experience: Manage daily/weekly service loss analysis and share RCCA for top loss parts. Involves detailed root cause analysis for discrepancy between systems and documentation of the same. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools, and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Extensive Experience: Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience. Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position. Communicates well downward, upward, and outward. Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience: Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts. Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate. Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems. Data Gathering and Reporting: Knowledge of tools, techniques, and processes for gathering and reporting data; ability to practice them in a particular department or division of a company. Level Working Knowledge: Assesses common problems and obstacles surrounding data-gathering. Interprets and explains results of a data-gathering initiative. Participates in projects to gather data for needs analysis. Data Visualization: Knowledge of principles, techniques and processes of data visualization; ability to create high quality figures effectively for various business scenarios and storytelling. Level Working Knowledge: Creates figures for regular data visualization tasks in an honest and compelling way. Develops or uses appropriate tools and software, such as Tableau and Power BI to generate different types of data visualization. Follows established standards and procedures to obtain, aggregate and analyze data for visualization. Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of India which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers. What You Will Get: Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date). Final Details: Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status. If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you! This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Accountant (Lead Analyst R2R) to join GLBL Bus Svcs RTR – Global Finance Services Division. The Record to Report (RTR) professional plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of financial accounting and reporting activities. This position supports the end-to-end financial close process while maintaining compliance with GAAP, internal controls, and organizational policies. The role combines strong accounting expertise, analytical capability, and stakeholder collaboration to deliver reliable financial information that supports business decision-making. The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore Office, KA-India What you will do Maintain financial records and accounting transactions in compliance with GAAP, statutory requirements, and company policies. Prepare, review, and analyze journal entries, account reconciliations, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities. Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of the general ledger and supporting financial documentation. Generate, validate, and distribute financial reports for management, auditors, and external stakeholders. Support financial statement preparation and reporting requirements across multiple legal entities and business units. Develop, enhance, and leverage automation tools and reporting solutions to improve the efficiency, accuracy, and timeliness of financial processes. Perform financial analysis to identify trends, variances, risks, and opportunities for business improvement. Support internal and external audit requests and ensure adherence to internal control requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve accounting issues and drive continuous process improvements. Contribute to standardization, operational excellence, and digital transformation initiatives within the RTR organization. What you will have 3-4 years of Accounting Degree or equivalent. Professional Certification from CA/CMA institute/US CPA/CMA preferrable 4-5 years of relevant experience in captive accounting service centers or large corporates with Manufacturing, Service & Trading nature of business. Expert in handling multiple ERP's and varied accounting tools Expert in Data Analytical skills and Interpretation of results Expert in understanding end to end accounting/business issues Shift Timing: EAME shift 1PM-10PM This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office. Skill Descriptors: Accuracy and Attention to Detail Understanding the importance of precision and quality in financial processes and reporting; ability to consistently deliver accurate and reliable results. Level: Extensive Experience Champions and contributes to accounting and reporting best practices. Accurately processes and reviews large volumes of complex financial data. Maintains an effective balance between productivity, quality, and compliance requirements. Establishes controls and review mechanisms to ensure data integrity and minimize errors. Drives a culture of quality and accountability within the team. Demonstrates advanced knowledge of quality assurance techniques, compliance standards, and validation methodologies. Analytical Thinking Knowledge of analytical tools and methodologies; ability to evaluate information, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions to business and operational challenges. Level: Working Knowledge Evaluates accounting and financial issues by identifying key drivers and business impacts. Systematically assesses alternative solutions and recommends appropriate actions. Utilizes analytical tools and methodologies to identify trends, patterns, and process improvement opportunities. Understands the broader business implications of financial data and operational decisions. Applies logical reasoning and professional judgment to interpret data and support decision-making. Effective Communications Ability to communicate information clearly, professionally, and effectively across all organizational levels. Level: Working Knowledge Provides constructive and actionable feedback focused on continuous improvement. Actively listens, seeks clarification when needed, and incorporates feedback effectively. Prepares clear reports, presentations, and business documentation. Communicates complex financial concepts in a concise and understandable manner for diverse audiences and avoid technical jargon when inappropriate. Demonstrates awareness of verbal and non-verbal communication cues to strengthen stakeholder engagement. Managing Multiple Priorities Ability to effectively manage competing priorities, deadlines, and stakeholder expectations in a dynamic environment. Level: Extensive Experience Successfully manages multiple concurrent activities and deliverables. Adjusts priorities to meet changing business requirements and deadlines. Anticipates and proactively addresses resource constraints and scheduling conflicts. Collaborates with stakeholders to reprioritize activities while maintaining service commitments. Maintains high levels of performance during peak close cycles and business-critical periods. Demonstrates adaptability and resilience in fast-paced, evolving environments. Problem Solving Knowledge of problem-solving methodologies and the ability to identify, analyze, and resolve accounting, operational and organizational challenges. Level: Working Knowledge Identifies, documents, and analyzes accounting and process-related issues. Evaluates the perspectives and requirements of key stakeholders when determining solutions. Assesses the validity, reliability, and relevance of financial information. Analyzes risks and impacts of alternative solutions and supports decision-making processes. Utilizes structured problem-solving techniques and root cause analysis tools to drive effective resolutions. Accounting Knowledge of accounting principles, standards, processes, and systems; ability to accurately record, analyze, and report financial information. Level: Working Knowledge Applies accounting principles and industry best practices in daily operations. Processes and reviews financial transactions in compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements. Supports the classification, recording, and reconciliation of financial data. Maintains charts of accounts and related financial master data structures. Ensures accurate reporting and compliance within enterprise financial systems. Supports month-end and year-end closing activities, including journal entries and account reconciliations. Financial Analysis Knowledge of financial analysis methodologies and the ability to interpret financial information to support business decisions. Level: Working Knowledge Analyzes financial data to identify business performance drivers, trends, and risks. Interprets financial statements and related disclosures to provide meaningful insights. Utilizes quantitative and qualitative analytical techniques to support decision-making. Leverages financial systems and analytical tools to perform data-driven evaluations. Provides recommendations based on sound financial analysis and business considerations. Financial Reporting Knowledge of financial reporting frameworks, processes, and controls; ability to prepare accurate and meaningful financial reports. Level: Working Knowledge Prepares and reviews financial reports in accordance with organizational standards and reporting requirements. Identifies, investigates, and resolves reporting discrepancies and data quality issues. Utilizes reporting tools and systems to develop accurate and timely financial reports. Ensures compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and reporting guidelines. Supports the preparation of management reports, statutory reporting, and audit-related deliverables. Contributes to continuous improvement of reporting processes, controls, and automation initiatives. What you will get: Work Life Harmony Earned and medical leave. Relocation assistance Holistic Development Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe Career developments opportunities with global prospects Health and Wellness Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage Employee mental wellness assistance program Financial Wellness Employee investment plan Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan. jobDescription:

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Your Work Shapes the World Whether it be groundbreaking products, best in class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do the work that matters at Caterpillar. With a 100-years legacy of quality and innovation and 150 locations in countries around the world, your impact spans the globe. When you join Caterpillar, you are joining a team of makers, innovators, and doers. We are the people who roll up our sleeves and do the work to build a better world. And we are proud of that, because it helps our customers build and power the world, we live in – the roads, hospitals, homes, and infrastructure. Without a dedicated workforce, Caterpillar could not effectively meet our customers’ needs. Join us. Job Summary: The Large Power Systems Division currently has an opening for a performance analyst who will utilize commercial and internal tools and analytical techniques (1-D and 3-D simulation tools) to provide simulation support for lubrication systems across various Caterpillar large engine platforms, with the opportunity to also work on engine water system simulations. This includes development of models to simulate oil pumps, engine oil galleries, valves, and heat exchangers in both steady-state and transient conditions (e.g., time to prime simulations), as well as 3-D simulations of piston cooling with oil jets. This position will also be a key player in the development of new methods and processes for 1-D and 3-D lubrication simulation, including investigations of the Lattice-Boltzmann vs. finite volume methods. The engineer will effectively collaborate with the various product development teams to deliver validated design solutions for our challenging program deliverables. The position includes strong collaboration with our design, system, and validation partners. What will you do: Analyze designs and concepts to achieve functional lubrication system requirements Develop system layouts, component selection, sizing and optimizing lube systems using 1-D & 3-D simulation tools Conduct lube component CFD to determine performance characteristics Understand oil level dynamic change in various operating conditions, oil splashing, sloshing and oil flooding/starvation under different driving conditions, to assure lubrication requirements are met under all conditions Conduct piston cooling and time to prime simulation (e.g., turbocharger lubrication) Develop engine water circuit models to size pumps and other components Collaborate with engine platform partners and customers to meet technical requirements Communicate simulation results to engine teams, component teams and customers Collaborate with test engineers and correlate simulation models Perform simulation to assist in resolving lubrication system related field problems Contribute to improvements in simulation methods and processes Help to establish technical requirements and specifications for new products What you must have: Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Agricultural, or Aerospace engineering or similar) Relevant engineering experience: Bachelor’s degree: 5+ years Master’s degree: 2+ years Doctorate degree Experience in CFD and/or 1-D engine, power systems, machine systems, or lubrication system simulation Strong background and interest in thermo-sciences Clear verbal and written communication skills Project management skills allowing handling of multiple projects and priorities Top Candidates will also have: Master or Doctorate degree in Mechanical, Agricultural or Aerospace engineering or similar Strong technical knowledge with the ability to communicate technical information effectively with team members and others in the work group, and process partners Working knowledge of engine, lubrication/ powertrain cooling and/or electrification systems 2+ years of experience using Fluent, 1-D analysis tools (i.e., GT-Suite) and Creo Additional Information: This position may require up to 10% travel This position is located in World Trade Center, Chennai, Tamil Nadu Relocation assistance is available for this position Additional information: This job requires 5 working days from office. This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Role Definition Designs, develops, validates mechanical systems and enclosure solutions for power conversion products, including inverter cabinets, charger cabinets, power distribution equipment, switchgear cabinets, and containerized electrical systems. Responsible for translating system requirements into robust, manufacturable, cost-effective mechanical designs from concept development through production release. Key Responsibilities Product Design & Development Lead the mechanical design and development of inverter cabinets, battery charger cabinets, power conversion enclosures, and switchgear systems from concept to production. Develop cabinet architectures, structural frameworks, mounting arrangements, cooling systems, access provisions, cable routing, and serviceability features. Create detailed 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, BOMs, and engineering documentation. Define enclosure layouts considering electrical clearances, creepage distances, thermal management, ingress protection (IP), EMC requirements, maintainability, and safety standards. Design sheet metal, fabricated structures, welded assemblies, busbar support structures, mounting brackets, doors, locks, hinges, and internal equipment arrangements. Participate in product architecture reviews and cross-functional design reviews with electrical, manufacturing, sourcing, and quality teams. Thermal & Structural Design Develop cooling concepts utilizing natural convection, forced-air ventilation, heat exchangers, or liquid-cooling interfaces as required. Perform or support structural, vibration, seismic, to ensure product reliability and compliance. Evaluate cabinet strength, transportation loads, lifting provisions, and environmental performance requirements. Manufacturing & Supplier Collaboration Work closely with fabrication suppliers and manufacturing teams to optimize designs for manufacturability, assembly, installation, and cost. Support prototype builds, factory testing, design validation activities, and issue resolution. Assist sourcing and supplier quality teams with supplier selection, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities. Drive cost reduction, value engineering, and standardization initiatives. Verification & Compliance Develop and execute design verification plans. Support certification and compliance activities related to applicable industry standards. Investigate field issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent engineering discipline. 6+ years of hands-on mechanical design experience in design and development of enclosures and structures for electrical equipment, power electronics, switchgear, power conversion systems, or related industries. Proven experience designing inverter cabinets, charger cabinets, switchgear enclosures, electrical control cabinets, or containerized power systems from the ground up. Experience with sheet metal design, structural fabrication, and enclosure development. Proficiency in 3D CAD tools such as Creo, Solid Works, NX, or equivalent. Preferred Qualifications Experience with: Utility-scale energy storage systems (BESS) Power conversion systems (PCS) Renewable energy products UPS systems EV charging infrastructure MV/LV switchgear Containerized electrical substations or E-Houses Familiarity with IEC, UL, NEMA, IP, and electrical equipment enclosure standards. Knowledge of thermal management and cooling system design. Experience coordinating with electrical engineering teams on controls, power electronics, and cable management design. This job requires working from office 5days in a week. Posting Dates: September 10, 2026

The Technical Information Solutions (TIS) team within Product Support & Logistics Division (PSLD) creates and delivers technical parts and service information accessible via SIS and SIS2GO critical for the repair and service of Caterpillar products. Over 300,000 dealer and customer users depend on the information created, managed, and delivered by this team to identify and order Cat parts. Job Summary In TIS, the Parts Information Graphic Specialist creates and maintains technical parts information for Caterpillar products. What You Will Do Creates and revises technical parts information graphics in support of new product introduction, continuous process improvement, and revision timelines. Ensures all parts information graphics are created accurately and participates in process improvement efforts. Validates prints to ensure information elements are documented as per Caterpillar standards. Validate the relevant part has a clear and descriptive graphics associated with the part. title: Territory Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Role Purpose Lead MWM’s direct commercial development in India by identifying, developing and closing new equipment and lifecycle service opportunities with end users and other direct project stakeholders. The Territory Manager will establish MWM as a visible, technically credible and commercially responsive partner in the Indian power generation market, with priority on gas engine generator applications. This is a direct market role. The position is not responsible for building or managing a dealership network. The successful candidate will create demand, own strategic customer relationships, and lead opportunities directly for MWM, while coordinating qualified EPCs, engineering firms, and service providers on a project-specific basis as required. Key Responsibilities Own MWM’s direct sales development across India for gas engine generator sets, power modules, combined heat and power solutions, and related lifecycle offerings. Build and manage a strong pipeline of direct opportunities with industrial end users, utilities, independent power producers, data centers, oil and gas companies, petrochemical and chemical plants, steel, cement, mining, food and beverage, textiles, pharmaceuticals, commercial infrastructure and other energy-intensive industries. Develop strategic account plans for priority customers and convert market potential into qualified projects, tenders, orders and long-term customer relationships. Engage early with customer decision-makers, plant engineering teams, consultants, EPC organizations and project developers to position MWM during concept development, feasibility studies, FEED and specification stages. Lead the complete opportunity cycle from prospecting and qualification through application definition, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, order intake and structured handover. Translate customer operating requirements into clear technical-commercial inputs, including fuel composition, gas pressure, site conditions, load profile, operating mode, heat recovery requirements, installation concept and commissioning expectations. Coordinate closely with application engineering, quotation, project management, service, finance, legal, and commercial teams to prepare compliant and competitive solutions. Lead value-based selling by quantifying customer benefits such as fuel efficiency, availability, lifecycle cost, emissions performance, operational flexibility and serviceability. Develop and maintain relationships with relevant EPCs, consultants and engineering companies as project influencers and execution partners, without assigning dealer or territory rights. Identify service, overhaul, long-term maintenance, upgrade, spare parts, and installed-base opportunities that strengthen customer lifecycle value. Maintain accurate opportunity, forecast, customer and activity data in the company CRM system and provide clear monthly outlooks, risks, actions and market intelligence. Represent MWM at targeted customer workshops, technical seminars, industry associations, conferences and exhibitions in India. Monitor competitive activity, pricing dynamics, regulations, gas availability, segment trends, and customer investment plans, and convert findings into actionable sales priorities. Achieve agreed order intake, revenue, margin, pipeline quality and strategic account development objectives while following internal governance and approval processes. Target Candidate Profile 8 to 12 years of progressive experience in technical B2B sales, business development or key-account management in the Indian power generation market. Preferred experience with gas engine generators, reciprocating engine power plants, cogeneration or trigeneration, distributed energy, captive power, waste-to-energy, biogas, natural gas, special gas or hybrid power solutions. Demonstrated success in direct selling to end users and managing complex, project-based sales cycles with multiple technical and commercial stakeholders. Established market access and customer relationships in one or more priority segments such as industrial captive power, oil and gas, petrochemicals, data centers, utilities, infrastructure, manufacturing or process industries. Strong understanding of the Indian project ecosystem, including direct customers, EPCs, consultants, tender processes, regulatory considerations and commercial practices. Ability to engage at plant, engineering, procurement, finance, and senior management levels and to build credibility with both technical and commercial decision-makers. Commercial ownership, disciplined follow-up and a proven ability to progress opportunities from early-stage lead to signed order. Willingness to travel extensively within India and, when required, internationally for customer meetings, factory visits, training and business reviews. Education Preferred degrees: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, power engineering, energy engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. B.E. or B. Tech is preferred. An M.E., MTech, or an MBA in Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or General Management is advantageous. Candidates with another relevant engineering degree may be considered where supported by strong, directly relevant power-generation sales experience. Technical and Commercial Knowledge Working knowledge of gas engines, generator sets, alternators, balance of plant, electrical integration and power plant operating concepts. Understanding of captive power, grid-parallel and island operation, base-load applications, CHP or CCHP, containerized and powerhouse installations, and high-ambient site conditions. Ability to interpret customer specifications, single-line concepts, fuel-gas data, load profiles and technical-commercial tender requirements. Competence in solution selling, financial justification, contract negotiation, risk identification, pricing discipline and stakeholder management. Experience with CRM-based pipeline management and forecasting. Salesforce experience is preferred. Strong written and spoken English. Proficiency in Hindi and additional Indian languages is advantageous. Core Competencies Direct customer acquisition and strategic account development Technical sales and consultative value selling Business development and market creation Complex opportunity and tender management Negotiation, commercial judgment, and closing discipline Customer focus and long-term relationship management Cross-functional coordination and clear communication Decision-making, accountability, and structured execution Market intelligence and competitive positioning Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline Measures of Success Achievement of approved new equipment and service order-intake, revenue, and margin objectives. Growth and quality of the qualified direct-customer pipeline. Conversion of strategic opportunities and acquisition of new MWM customers in India. Early specification and positioning of MWM in priority projects. Development of sustainable relationships with end users, EPCs and consultants. Forecast accuracy, opportunity data quality and timely execution of agreed next steps. Customer satisfaction and effective coordination from opportunity development through handover. Positioning Statement for Candidates This role offers the opportunity to shape MWM’s direct market presence in India. It is suited to a commercially ambitious power-generation professional who wants to build strategic customer relationships, influence complex energy projects and take visible ownership of growth in one of MWM’s priority markets. Job Description Notice This job description is intended as a general guide to the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or effort required. The company may revise the description to address evolving business and organizational needs. Final title, grade, reporting line, targets, and employment conditions remain subject to approval by management and Human Resources. Additional information: This job requires 5days in a week working from office. Posting Dates: September 9, 2026

jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Data Specialist (Senior Data Engineer) join our Financial Systems Tech Support -CAT IT Division We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a good foundation in data engineering principles, a keen analytical mindset, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. As a Junior Data Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and infrastructure to support our organization's data needs. The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN What you will do Data Pipeline Development Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store large volumes of data from various sources. Implement data workflows using ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure data quality and integrity. Data Integration and Management Collaborate with data architects, product owners, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver data solutions that meet their needs. Integrate data from multiple sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, into a unified data platform. Manage and optimize data storage solutions, ensuring efficient data retrieval and processing. Data Quality and Governance Implement data quality checks and validation processes to ensure the accuracy and consistency of data. Adhere to data governance policies and best practices to maintain data security and compliance. Performance Optimization Monitor and optimize data pipeline performance to ensure timely and efficient data processing. Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and system issues to maintain data pipeline reliability. Documentation and Collaboration Document data engineering processes, workflows, and solutions for future reference and knowledge sharing. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making and project initiatives. What you will have Education and Experience Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field. 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, or software development. Technical Skills Strong experience on advanced SQL any Database. (Oracle, Teradata, snowflake). Experience in data integration area and hands on experience in any of the ETL tools like Datastage , Informatica , Snaplogic etc. Able to transform technical requirements into data collection query. Should be capable of working with business and other IT teams and convert the requirements into queries. Good understanding of ETL architecture and design. Good knowledge in Databases, SQL, or PL/SQL Good experience with CI/CD tools such as Github Actions (Az DO pipelines) Good to have knowledge on Unix commands Good to have an experience on AWS Glue Good to have knowledge on Qlik replication tool This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office. Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST Soft Skills Good analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment. Eagerness to learn new technologies and stay updated with industry trends. Skills desired: Value Realization: Knowledge of value realization methods; ability to plan, execute, monitor and manage business activities and resources to determine and achieve the actual value from a business initiative as estimated in an associated business case. Level Basic Understanding: • Describes the importance of Value Realization milestones for long-term projects. • Assists in measuring and attaining post-project implementation value. • Identifies process changes or business value integration in change initiative plans and activities. • Contributes to project team communication regarding the linkage of a change initiative to its associated business goals and case. Communicating Complex Concepts: Knowledge of effective presentation tools and techniques to ensure clear understanding; ability to use summarization and simplification techniques to explain complex technical concepts in simple, clear language appropriate to the audience. Level Working Knowledge: • Uses comparisons to familiar ideas when introducing a technical or novel feature. • Separates fundamental concepts from supporting details in explaining a product or service. • Explains products and services with little or no use of technical jargon or advanced vocabulary. • Emphasizes the most important facts or features of a product or service. • Perceives lack of audience comprehension; further simplifies explanation when needed. Agile Development: Knowledge of agile methodologies and the agile development lifecycle; ability to utilize formal agile methodologies, disciplines, practices and techniques for the delivery of new and enhanced applications. Level Working Knowledge: • Explains a specific agile process and its associated checkpoints and deliverables. • Works with a specific agile development methodology. • Interprets metrics used to measure progress and effectiveness. • Defines key selection and qualifying criteria for projects suitable for agile development. • Applies major tools and techniques associated with the specific methodology. Cloud Computing: Knowledge of cloud-based solutions and their applications; ability to design, implement, and manage cloud-based solutions to meet business needs and improve operational efficiency. Level Working Knowledge: • Designs and implements a cloud-based solution to meet a specific business need or requirement. • Configures and deploys cloud-based infrastructure, such as virtual machines, storage, and networks. • Migrates applications and data to a cloud-based environment, including data migration and integration. • Implements cloud-based security measures, such as access controls, encryption, and firewalls. • Troubleshoots and resolves common cloud-based issues, such as connectivity problems and performance degradation. Database Design (Physical): Knowledge of database systems; ability to establish a data model for designing an organization's database that runs effectively and efficiently for better business outcome. Level Working Knowledge: • Researches relationships between different business data sets. • Participates in the establishment of data structures based on their relationships. • Adheres to an organization's database design policies. • Utilizes database design tools and techniques. • Tests the effectiveness of the database before its release for business use. ETL Process: Knowledge of the extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) process; ability to develop a database through the ETL process. Job Description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Accountant (Finance Transformation Manager
- Analytics COE) to join our COE-Accountable Reporting -Global Finance Services Division The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield, Bangalore-KA , India What you will do: The Finance Transformation Lead plays a senior role within the Analytics Center of Excellence (COE) – Continuous Improvement (CI), accountable for shaping, leading, and delivering complex finance transformation initiatives across global finance operations. This role is designed for a high-performing, tech‑savvy finance transformation professional with 8–12 years of experience, typically gained through management consulting, advanced analytics, finance systems, or large‑scale finance transformation programs. The position requires strong strategic thinking, solution design capability, and stakeholder influence, acting as a trusted advisor to senior finance leaders while ensuring measurable business value delivery. Key Responsibilities Finance Transformation Leadership Lead end‑to‑end finance transformation and CI initiatives across global finance processes, from opportunity identification through solution design, execution, and value realization. Own the design of standardized, scalable, future‑state finance processes, emphasizing simplification, controls, and exception elimination rather than exception automation. Shape transformation roadmaps, including initiative prioritization, investment framing, value cases, and delivery milestones. Act as a design authority for finance process, analytics, and digital enablement initiatives within the CI / Analytics COE governance. Analytics COE & Digital Enablement Serve as a senior finance–analytics–technology integrator, translating business strategy into analytics, data, and system requirements. Guide the use of analytics, automation, and emerging digital/AI capabilities to improve insight quality, operational efficiency, and scalability. Ensure strong data governance, metric consistency, and reporting integrity across initiatives. Stakeholder Management & Strategic Influence Partner closely with GBS, Finance Leadership, Continuous Improvement Leads, Tower SMEs, Analytics teams, and IT to align transformation priorities and execution. Facilitate executive‑level discussions, workshops, and decision forums using a structured, consulting‑style approach. Prepare and present clear, data‑driven executive communications, including roadmaps, business cases, progress updates, and impact reporting. Influence outcomes in complex, matrixed environments, often without direct authority. Delivery Oversight & Capability Building Provide direction, coaching, and informal leadership to project resources, analysts, or junior transformation roles supporting initiatives. Ensure disciplined execution, risk management, and benefit tracking across the transformation portfolio. Contribute to the maturation of Continuous Improvement and Analytics COE ways of working, methodologies, and playbooks. What you will have: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field. 8–12 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following: Finance transformation or continuous improvement leadership Management / finance transformation consulting Advanced analytics or data‑driven finance roles Finance systems, ERP, or digital transformation programs Strong understanding of end‑to‑end finance processes, performance drivers, and operating models. Proven ability to lead complex, cross‑functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders. This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office. Preferred Profile & Skills (Strongly Desired) Senior tech‑savvy finance transformation profile, such as: Former management or finance transformation consultant Analytics‑led finance leader Finance systems / digital transformation specialist Deep data and analytics mindset: KPI design, data lineage, quality controls, and insight generation. High technology literacy: strong understanding of modern finance platforms, analytics, automation, and AI enablement (hands‑on coding not required). Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and change‑leadership skills. Strong ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic execution. Skills desired: Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Extensive Experience: • Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices. • Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy. • Productively balances speed and accuracy. • Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals. • Implements a variety of cross-checking approaches and mechanisms. • Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards. Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Working Knowledge: • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance. • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions. • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns. • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand. • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
