Job Summary We are seeking an IT Analyst Technical Infrastructure ( Open VMS Systems Administrator) to join our IT Infrastructure Support
- CAT IT Division. The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule. Shift Timing : 01:00-10:00PM IST Position Summary The Open VMS Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, monitoring, and support of mission-critical Open VMS environments supporting warehouse automation, parts distribution, and manufacturing applications across multiple global locations. This role provides operational support for both physical Open VMS Integrity servers and emulated Open VMS environments hosted on Vere Technologies virtual servers, ensuring high availability, system performance, security, and business continuity for critical enterprise applications. Key Responsibilities Open VMS Infrastructure Administration Administer and maintain a production Open VMS Cluster Monitor and maintain Open VMS operating systems and associated layered products. Plan, test, and implement operating system upgrades, patches, and software updates. Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and application-related issues. Perform performance analysis and capacity planning activities. Coordinate maintenance activities to minimize operational impact. Virtual Open VMS Environment Support Administer emulated Open VMS servers Apply upgrades, patches, and software maintenance to Vere Technologies platforms and supporting infrastructure. Monitor virtual host performance and resource utilization. User and Security Administration Create, modify, and disable Open VMS user accounts according to approved access requests. Manage user privileges and security settings in accordance with company policies. Support audit and compliance requirements related to system access and security controls. System Monitoring and Operations Monitor system health, availability, and performance across all Open VMS environments. Manage and monitor: Disk capacity and utilization Printer queues Batch processing queues System backups and recovery processes Investigate and resolve operational incidents and system alerts. Maintain documentation for procedures, configurations, and system changes. Backup and Disaster Recovery Execute and validate backup procedures for physical and virtual Open VMS systems. Support disaster recovery testing and recovery planning activities. Ensure backup integrity and data recoverability. Global Support Provide infrastructure support for multiple business applications, including the widely utilized CAPP+ application environment. Collaborate with application teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and infrastructure teams to resolve system issues and implement enhancements. Support global business operations requiring high system availability and reliability. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. Extensive experience administering Open VMS operating systems. Experience supporting Open VMS Cluster environments. Knowledge of Open VMS system management, storage, user administration, and security. Experience applying operating system patches, upgrades, and software maintenance. Experience managing backups, disaster recovery processes, and system monitoring. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Experience supporting mission-critical production environments. Preferred Qualifications Experience with HPE Integrity Server hardware. Experience with Vere Technologies Open VMS emulation solutions. Knowledge of warehouse management systems and automated material handling environments. Experience supporting global enterprise applications. Familiarity with high-availability and business continuity practices. Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, or parts distribution environments. Key Competencies Infrastructure Administration Open VMS Systems Management Cluster Administration Incident Management Change Management Performance Monitoring Capacity Planning Disaster Recovery Problem Solving Technical Documentation Customer Service Cross-Functional Collaboration Scope of Responsibility Supports a few physical Open VMS Integrity servers, including a production Open VMS Cluster and test environment. Supports several emulated Open VMS servers hosted on 9 Vere Technologies virtual servers. Maintains Vere Technologies license servers. Supports international locations across North America, South America, Europe, and Australia. Provides operational support for mission-critical warehouse automation and parts distribution systems that directly impact order fulfillment and business operations. Skill Descriptors Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges. Level Working Knowledge: • Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues. • Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components. • Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services. • Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence. • Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues. Technology Advising: Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain. Level Working Knowledge: • Assesses the current technology environment, expressed needs and initiatives of client organizations. • Uses an effective consulting method to present technology solutions that resolve stated client business issues. • Advises clients regarding a family of specific products, technologies or services in a technology domain. • Demonstrates basic competence and sound business knowledge regarding specific products, technologies or services within a domain of technology expertise. • Achieves consulting relationship rating of 'professional' by delivering timely, meaningful advice meeting client needs in a narrow set of specific technologies. Hardware Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and systems programming; ability to design, build and integrate IT hardware into multi-platforms for the organization. Level Working Knowledge: • Assists in integrating IT hardware with the organization's existing systems. • Participates in the implementation of IT hardware within the organization. • Tracks operational problems related to IT hardware and reports them directly to the supervisor. • Assists in designing the main features of IT hardware according to business needs. • Compares IT hardware across one's own organization and its competitors. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge: • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements. • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis. • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements. • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements. • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis. System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Working Knowledge: • Supports the project leader in developing and executing system test plans. • Evaluates system documentation and user manuals for usability, accuracy and completeness. • Executes test cases, analyzes test results and reports on findings regularly. • Tests system components for compliance with functional requirements. • Participates in the testing of a system's ability to recover from hardware or software failures. Systems Software Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and system software interaction; ability to design and build a fundamental architecture of operating systems, database management systems, communications protocols, compilers and other development tools. Level Working Knowledge: • Reports software connectivity and integration issues. • Demonstrates planned software changes on the local environment. • Administers software migration and contingency plans related to own function. • Analyzes the local software architecture components and products. • Tests key features for the entire software infrastructure environment. Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Working Knowledge: • Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems. • Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities. • Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards. • Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting. • Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used. Technical Writing/Documentation: Knowledge of technical writing; ability to write technical documents such as manuals, reports, guidelines or documents on standards, processes and applications. Level Working Knowledge: • Implements technical documentation standards, guidelines and best practices. • Prepares written text and layout of materials according to required outlines and specifications. • Completes and maintains technical reference documents. • Uses the major features, functions and facilities of an automated documentation tool. • Coordinates and constantly updates system operations, installations, service manuals, and help documents. Job Summary The QA Validation Architect provides technical leadership for validation and quality assurance for Mine Star modernisation programs. This role owns the test strategy, validation execution, and quality governance for phase‑wise modernisation from legacy to modern platforms. The role requires strong technical depth, automation expertise, and leadership to ensure releases meet acceptance criteria, built‑in quality standards, and deployment readiness goals . Hands‑on experience with automation tools and frameworks, including Cucumber and Playwright Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC in Agile and SAFe environments Solid knowledge of non‑functional testing methodologies (performance, reliability, scalability, security) Strong risk assessment and decision‑making capabilities related to quality and releases Posting Dates: September 9, 2026

Job Summary We are seeking a skilled hands-on IT Analyst Technical Infrastructure (ITSM reporting/SLM Metrics) to join our ITSM team – Caterpillar IT, India GCC. The role involves design, develop, deploy and maintain enterprise ITSM data, analytics, reporting, automation and AI capabilities. The role will support Service Now reporting and Platform Analytics, Snowflake data structures, Power BI dashboards, Python/SQL-based automation, service-level metrics and data governance. The incumbent will partner with ITSM process owners and business stakeholders to provide reliable operational insights, improve reporting efficiency and enable data-driven decisions across Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Level Management. The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN , Whitefield What you will do Job Duties/Responsibilities will include: Design, develop and maintain enterprise ITSM dashboards, reports and analytical solutions using Microsoft Power BI, Service Now and Platform Analytics. Develop and maintain Snowflake tables, views, queries and data models supporting ITSM reporting, service-level metrics and operational analysis. Use Python and SQL to automate data preparation, validation, reconciliation and recurring reporting activities. Maintain data quality, reporting accuracy, metric definitions and appropriate governance for ITSM data consumed through Service Now, Snowflake, Power BI and approved AI solutions. Support the modernization and migration of legacy ITSM reporting and Service Now Platform Analytics solutions. Analyze Incident, Problem, Change and Release data to identify recurring issues, root-cause trends, operational risks and improvement opportunities. Develop reporting for SLA performance, service-level trends and business-facing service reviews. Partner with ITSM process owners and stakeholders to translate business and operational requirements into reliable analytical solutions. Create clear technical documentation, data definitions, operational procedures and knowledge-transfer materials. Support testing, deployment, monitoring and maintenance of reports, data pipelines and automation solutions. Develop or support approved Microsoft Copilot and agent-based solutions for ITSM use cases. Participate in ITSM governance activities, including Incident, Problem, Change, CAB/e CAB, Release, Service Level Management and IT controls. Provide production support for critical reporting and analytics solutions, including planned off-hours or weekend support when required. Contribute into ITSM responsibilities
- Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management processes within Service Now Root cause analysis, trend identification, recurring issue elimination, and service improvement initiatives Enterprise CAB (Americas, EMEA, APAC), ICW calendar coordination, e CAB facilitation, and moratorium governance Service level monitoring, SLA reporting, stakeholder alignment, and continual service improvement Service Now release testing, Platform Analytics migration initiatives, and tool governance activities IT controls, compliance, audit readiness, and process documentation Development and support of Agentic AI, Microsoft Copilot, Sidekick, and automation solutions that improve ITSM processes, reporting, knowledge management, and operational efficiency What you will have Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Five or more years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data engineering or a related technology area. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI, including data modelling, dashboard development and report maintenance. Working proficiency in Python and SQL for analytics, automation and data processing. Experience working with Snowflake, Data Lake or comparable cloud data platforms. Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data, validate results and communicate actionable insights. Strong written and verbal communication, customer-service, teamwork and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to manage priorities independently while working effectively in a global, collaborative environment. Preferred Experience with Service Now reporting, Performance Analytics or Platform Analytics. Familiarity with ITSM or ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Level Management. Experience developing solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform or comparable AI and automation technologies. Experience with data governance, data access controls, metric definitions and reporting-quality assurance. ITIL Foundation, Microsoft Power BI, Service Now or Snowflake certification. This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week in the office from 1pm -10pm IST. Skills desired: Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges. Level Extensive Experience: • Advises others on the assessment and provision of all technical solutions. • Engages appropriate subject matter resources to effectively resolve technical issues. • Mentors others to enhance their technical competence and its application to achieve more effective technical solutions. • Coaches others in promoting, defining, analyzing, and providing superior technical solutions to business problems. • Provides effective solutions to moderate technical challenges through strong technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues. • Assumes accountability for personal technical performance and holds others responsible for theirs. Technology Advising: Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain. Level Working Knowledge: • Assesses the current technology environment, expressed needs and initiatives of client organizations. • Uses an effective consulting method to present technology solutions that resolve stated client business issues. • Advises clients regarding a family of specific products, technologies or services in a technology domain. • Demonstrates basic competence and sound business knowledge regarding specific products, technologies or services within a domain of technology expertise. • Achieves consulting relationship rating of 'professional' by delivering timely, meaningful advice meeting client needs in a narrow set of specific technologies. Hardware Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and systems programming; ability to design, build and integrate IT hardware into multi-platforms for the organization. Level Extensive Experience: • Evaluates IT hardware vendors in the market and selects the most suitable products for the organization. • Guides employees on the integration of IT hardware throughout other organization-wide platforms. • Supervises the implementation process of IT hardware ensuring consistency in productivity and overall effectiveness. • Advises others on business standards and practices for IT hardware in order to meet designer requirements. • Evaluates the advantages and disadvantages of an organization's hardware components. • Diagnoses IT hardware problems and recommends dynamic solutions. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge: • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements. • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis. • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements. • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements. • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis. System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Extensive Experience: • Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices. • Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase. • Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications. • Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations. • Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation. • Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools. Systems Software Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and system software interaction; ability to design and build a fundamental architecture of operating systems, database management systems, communications protocols, compilers and other development tools. Level Working Knowledge: • Reports software connectivity and integration issues. • Demonstrates planned software changes on the local environment. • Administers software migration and contingency plans related to own function. • Analyzes the local software architecture components and products. • Tests key features for the entire software infrastructure environment. Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Extensive Experience: • Emphasizes the business impact of failure and the criticality and timing of needed resolution so that problems can be avoided in the future. • Creates trouble reports for all issues found and reviews solutions for completeness and correctness. • Directs the resolution of communications problems in multi-vendor environments. • Resolves a variety of hardware, software, and communications malfunctions. • Coaches others on advanced diagnostic techniques and tools for unusual or performance-related problems. • Facilitates the distribution of releases reports and correction packages to departments or clients. Technical Writing/Documentation: Knowledge of technical writing; ability to write technical documents such as manuals, reports, guidelines or documents on standards, processes and applications. Level Extensive Experience: • Conducts training on alternative documentation delivery mechanisms, tools and techniques. • Manages cost items in producing and maintaining documentation. • Designs and implements formal methodologies for producing documentation. • Collaborates with support function managers, the product management team, and design engineers with writing projects. • Supervises the analysis, design and data collation on large documentation initiatives. • Establishes and references best practices for existing and planned tools and delivery vehicles for proper documentation. What you will get: Work Life Harmony Earned and medical leave. Relocation assistance Holistic Development Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe Career developments opportunities with global prospects Health and Wellness Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage Employee mental wellness assistance program Financial Wellness Employee investment plan Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan. Additional Information: Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers This position requires working onsite five days a week. Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates: Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community. There’s more to work at Caterpillar than just the work itself. We hire smart, friendly people and it shows in our culture. We hold ourselves to high standards and make sure our values of integrity, excellence, teamwork, commitment and sustainability come to life in the way we work. We make sure our employees feel continuously challenged while also supported. We provide professional growth opportunities, including leadership programs. We celebrate the diversity of our team, while also working together as one Caterpillar. Our culture, like everything at our company, is made possible by each employee’s contribution. Person by person, we create the environment we work in, and we are proud of the Caterpillar we’ve built.

title: Lead Digital Architect
jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. JOB DUTIES: Seeking a highly skilled and visionary Data Architect to work with highly skilled engineers to build a robust next gen data platform. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical and functional expertise in Big Data, Data Warehousing, and end-to-end real-time data movement. You will architect and build Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital platform, while driving innovation in AI and advanced analytics. Competent to perform all programming and provide oversight for architecture assessment and design for development assignments without close supervision; normally assigned the more complex aspects of systems work. Lead Architecture design of end-to-end enterprise integrations that serves multiple business functions. Design and implement end-to-end near real-time data movement solutions that provide core capabilities for the enterprise. Define the overall data architecture strategy aligned with business goals. Establish data governance policies, standards, and compliance Drives application development focused around delivering business valuable features Maintains high standards of software quality within the team by establishing good practices and security guardrails per Enterprise standards. Knowledge of target architecture; ability to develop the IT blueprint and roadmap while aligning the architecture and processes with business strategies and objectives Develop and maintain current, planned, and future state architecture blueprints. Lead in the identification and analysis of enterprise business drivers and requirements that drive the future state architecture. Work with business analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders. Translate business requirements into technical data solutions Communicate with end users and stake holders to help direct development, debugging, and testing of application software for accuracy, integrity, interoperability, and completeness. Performs integrated testing and customer acceptance testing of components that requires careful planning and execution to ensure timely, quality results. Typical customers include Caterpillar customers, dealers, other external companies who purchase services offered by Caterpillar as well as internal business unit and/or service centre groups. The position is challenged to quickly and correctly identify problems that may not be obvious. The incumbent solves problems by determining the best architecture, within departmental guidelines, from many existing solutions. Basic

QUALIFICATIONS:

Four-year bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a Computer Science or Information Technology, or related field 12+ years or more of software development experience or at least 3 years of architecture experience with strong demonstrable experience. 5+ years or more of experience in designing conceptual, logical, and physical data models & data models support scalability, performance, and integration needs. 5+ years of Data Warehousing experience & optimizing database performance, indexing, and storage strategies Expert in implementing security measures for data at rest and in transit and defining access control, encryption, and compliance frameworks Strong in designing data integration solutions across systems ensuring smooth data flow between applications, APIs, and data warehouses Top candidates will also have proven experience in many of the following, Designing, developing, deploying and maintaining software at scale, with good understanding of concurrency. Working experience in Python as an Object-Oriented programming language In-Depth understanding of how Data pipelines work in Big Data & expert in designing architectures for cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure) for large-scale processing. Expertise and experience in building Large Data Lakes and Data Warehouse (Snowflake Preferred). Expertise in building end-to-end near real-time data pipelines for OLTP & OLAP. Strong architecture exposure for building robust Data Platforms Expertise in SQL and NO-SQL databases, Message brokers and other AWS services such as Kafka/Kinesis, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Lambda, API Gateway, Dynamo DB, Aurora, AWS RDS Postgre SQL. Test driven development and behaviour driven development. Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints. Passion for technology and an eagerness to contribute to a team-oriented environment. Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities. Strong understanding of AI concepts and latest developments (Gen AI, MCP, ATA, etc.). Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO). This position requires working onsite five days a week. Relocation is available for this position. Posting Dates: September 8, 2026

jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Key Responsibilities Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with organizational goals and workforce plans. Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and data-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions. Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessment coordination, reference checks, offer negotiation, and onboarding support. Utilize Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, and advanced sourcing tools to identify and engage top talent. Build and maintain robust talent pipelines to support current and future hiring needs. Implement sourcing strategies focused on attracting diverse and high-quality talent while optimizing time-to-fill and cost-per-hire metrics. Ensure a positive candidate experience through proactive communication and effective stakeholder management. Monitor recruitment metrics and leverage workforce analytics to improve hiring outcomes and process efficiencies. Promote employer branding initiatives and represent the organization positively in the talent marketplace. Ensure compliance with company policies, employment legislation, and recruitment best practices. Skill Descriptors Relationship Management Knowledge of relationship management techniques and the ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with business leaders, candidates, vendors, and peers. Influences hiring managers and business leaders through data-driven recommendations. Builds and maintains long-term partnerships with key stakeholders and external vendors. Customer/Market Focus Understanding of evolving market trends and the ability to respond to customer and business needs in a manner that consistently adds value. Identifies expressed and unexpressed business talent needs. Aligns recruiting strategies to critical business objectives. Recruitment Channel Management Knowledge of selecting, implementing, and managing recruitment channels to support talent acquisition objectives. Utilizes multiple recruitment channels to attract top talent. Identifies and manages cost-effective sourcing partners and recruitment vendors. Candidate Screening Knowledge of effective candidate assessment and screening methodologies. Screens candidates for professional, technical, and leadership roles. Ensures compliance with HR policies and recruitment standards throughout the screening process. Candidate Sourcing Knowledge of sourcing techniques, methods, and tools to attract top talent. Develops and executes multi-channel sourcing strategies. Advises business leaders on talent availability and sourcing approaches. Benchmarks sourcing strategies against industry best practices. Staffing and Recruiting Knowledge of staffing strategies, recruiting processes, and talent acquisition best practices. Manages complex recruitment assignments across multiple business functions. Consults with stakeholders on workforce planning, recruitment strategies, and talent availability. Workforce Analytics Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce trends, and reporting methodologies that support informed business decisions. Analyzes recruitment and workforce data to identify trends and opportunities. Generates reports and dashboards to support leadership decision-making. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. At minimal 4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, or Human Resources. Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment for technical, professional hiring. Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills. Experience using ATS, CRM platforms, Linked In Recruiter, and other sourcing technologies. Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume recruitment environment preferred. This position requires working onsite five days a week. Relocation is available for this position. jobDescription:

Caterpillar’s Connectivity System Team is hiring a Connectivity System Senior Engineer (System Integration / Product Owner) with expertise in telematics, connectivity platforms, and system integration across embedded and enterprise systems. In this role, you will work on highly complex and scalable connectivity solutions spanning across CAT and non-CAT assets. This role combines system integration engineering and product ownership, requiring end-to-end ownership of connectivity features across embedded systems, connectivity layers, and enterprise/cloud ecosystems. You will collaborate with global teams including Product Groups (RI, CI, P&E), Intelligent Machine Systems (IMS), Cat Digital, and platform teams to deliver high-quality, data-driven connectivity solutions aligned with customer and business needs. What You’ll Do (Job Duties) Own and manage connectivity features, driving end-to-end lifecycle from requirements definition, system design, integration, validation, and release Drive end-to-end system integration across embedded systems, connectivity modules (5G/LTE, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth), and enterprise/cloud platforms, ensuring consistent system behavior and readiness Act as a Product Owner, maintaining and prioritizing feature backlog (WSJF or similar), leading backlog grooming, and ensuring alignment with business priorities and system architecture Define and manage system and feature requirements (SRS/MFRD) with full traceability across system, software, and validation Collaborate with product teams, Cat Digital, architects, and onboard/offboard engineering teams to deliver scalable connectivity solutions aligned with customer use cases Lead system validation and quality assurance, ensuring full feature coverage, production readiness, and robust integration across all subsystems Perform deep system-level debugging and root cause analysis across embedded, connectivity, and cloud layers to resolve complex issues Apply DFMEA and Built-In Quality (BIQ) practices to proactively identify risks and ensure high system reliability Drive data-driven decision making using validation data, system insights, and field feedback to continuously improve performance and quality Support release management, including Go/No-Go decisions, release readiness, and tracking feature delivery Skill Descriptors Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level: Extensive Experience Seeks discrepancies and inconsistencies in available information; explains variances. Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation. Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research. Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action. Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviours. Level: Working Knowledge Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient. Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness. Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work. Teamwork: Knowledge of the necessity and value of teamwork; experience with; ability to work cooperatively towards shared goals and being supportive of others at all levels. Level: Working Knowledge Explains own role and responsibility within team. Actively participates in team meetings. Shares information, knowledge, and experiences openly and proactively. Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges. Level: Working Knowledge Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues. Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components. Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services. Producing Results: Understanding of the criticality of getting things done in spite of current circumstances and the ability to utilize assigned resources and leverage back-channel resources (individuals or teams) to achieve or exceed planned outcomes. Level: Working Knowledge Finds or creates ways to measure performance against goals. Identifies and exploits own strengths; solicits support from others to minimize limitations. Strives for excellence in performance by surpassing established standards. Software Development: Knowledge of software development tools and activities; ability to produce software products or systems in line with product requirements. Level: Extensive Experience Conducts walkthroughs and monitors effectiveness and quality of the development activities. Elaborates on multiple-development toolkits for traditional and web-based software. Has participated in development of multiple or large software products. Contrasts advantages and drawbacks of different development languages and tools. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level: Extensive Experience Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms. Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage. Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases. Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level: Working Knowledge Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems. Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities. Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards. Top Candidates Will Also Have Experience in Telematics / Connectivity / Io T systems, including 5G, embedded systems, and offboard integrations Understanding of latest technology advancements in connectivity, Io T, edge, and cloud platforms, and ability to apply them in defining new solutions Experience with Generative AI (Gen AI) tools and practices to improve engineering productivity, automation, and system analysis Experience with Agile development, backlog prioritization, and NPI/CPI processes Experience working in large, global, matrixed organizations Strong interest in innovation-driven engineering and continuous technology advancement Posting Dates: September 7, 2026

Contrasts advantages and drawbacks of different development languages and tools. Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage. Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases. Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level: Working Knowledge Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems. Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities. Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards. title: Senior Software Engineer - Automation Testing
jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience: 7+ years in software testing, with at least 5 years focused on test automation using Java and any Test tool Skills: Strong understanding of software testing methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall), excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and effective communication and collaboration skills Knowledge: Proven experience in testing Web Services, Web UI, and APIs , Mobile App, Salesforce applications

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Framework Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable test automation frameworks using tools like Playwright, Selenium. Acquire client requirements; resolve workflow problems through automation optimization.. Utilize automated testing tools to perform testing and maintenance Should have experience in customising default reports and libraries of playwright Test Case Automation: Develop and execute automated test cases for functional, regression, and integration testing CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines Test Data Management: Implement strategies for managing and provisioning test data efficiently Innovation: Works effectively to transform innovative ideas to fruition Troubleshooting: Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to automated tests Reporting: Generate comprehensive test reports and analyze results to identify trends and areas for improvement Mentorship: Mentor junior team members and collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders Experience using AI-assisted developer and testing tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Chat GPT) to improve test design, automation development, and productivity. Understanding of AI-powered testing concepts such as intelligent test generation, test optimization, and automated defect analysis. Skills: Automation Tools: Proficiency in Playwright, Selenium, Cucumber and other automation tools Programming Languages: Experience with Java, Java Script or other functional languages Database : Postgres & Snowflakes
- Well versed in writing SQL queries Cloud : Experience in leveraging core AWS services like EC2, S3, RDS, and Lambda for Test Automation. Familiarity with AWS architecture and best practices Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think of creative solutions to systems-based issues Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills Salesforce – Extensive Experience Demonstrates deep expertise in testing Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and custom Salesforce applications. Leads end-to-end validation of Salesforce integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, middleware, and third-party systems. Designs and implements scalable test strategies for Salesforce releases, including regression, integration, and UAT support. Analyzes complex Salesforce business processes, workflows, approval processes, validation rules, and automation logic to identify quality risks. Reviews and validates impacts of configuration and customization changes, including Apex, Lightning Components, Flows, and custom objects. Advises teams on Salesforce test data management, environment strategy, and release readiness practices. Evaluates cross-functional impacts of Salesforce enhancements and drives quality assurance across integrated business processes. Mentors team members on Salesforce testing best practices, automation opportunities, and enterprise quality engineering standards. Collaborates with administrators, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of Salesforce initiatives. Establishes quality metrics, defect trends, and release governance mechanisms to support Salesforce platform stability and continuous improvement. Level Extensive Experience: • Differentiates assumptions, perspectives, and historical frameworks. • Evaluates past decisions for insights to improve decision-making process. • Assesses and validates decision options and points and predicts their potential impact. • Advises others in analyzing and synthesizing relevant data and assessing alternatives. • Uses effective decision-making approaches such as consultative, command, or consensus. • Ensures that assumptions and received wisdom are objectively analyzed in decisions. title: Software Engineer - QA
jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Role Summary The Software Testing Engineer is responsible for driving quality engineering strategy, executing automation initiatives, and ensuring high test coverage across Caterpillar Dealer facing web application (Foresight). This role requires strong technical expertise in automation frameworks (Playwright & Selenium), and the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, reliable web solutions. What You Will Do Leadership & Strategy Define and implement the overall QA strategy aligning with product and organizational goals. Ensure best practices and skills are developed. Coordinate QA activities across Project Operations modules, ensuring clarity of scope and priorities. Facilitate triage calls, team meetings, and cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders. Automation Framework Ownership Design, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, and Rest Assured (Java/Python preferred). Upgrade or optimize existing frameworks for reliability, maintainability, CI/CD compatibility, and container-based test execution. Enable tagging, modularization, and classification of failures to support large-scale execution across Foresight modules. Test Planning & Execution Prepare, review, and maintain QA artifacts (test plans, cases, regression suites, reports). Ensure complete test coverage—functional, integration, API, end-to-end, performance, and batch job validation. Oversee defect triage, prioritization, and root cause analysis. Coordinate environment setup, test execution, and regression cycles across Dev/UAT/Prod releases. Performance & Reliability Oversight Collaborate with performance engineers to define SLAs and gather non-functional requirements. Monitor bottlenecks & flakiness Integrate performance regressions into CI/CD pipelines for timely detection of issues. Continuous Integration / Dev Ops Coordination Enable development teams with regression test suites for shift-left validation of breaking changes. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated test execution in Azure Dev Ops and Git Hub. Support deployments, verification cycles, and parallel release testing across development environments. Reporting & Governance Track KPIs such as defect density, test coverage, execution reliability, and automation ROI. Prepare dashboards, quality reports, and provide regular updates to stakeholders. Manage risks, dependencies, and ensure timely delivery of quality outcomes. What You Will Have Technical Expertise Strong expertise in automation tools: Playwright, Selenium Web Driver, Rest Assured, Robot Framework. Programming skills: Java, Java Script/Type Script, Python. Frameworks: Page Object Model (POM), BDD (Cucumber). API testing:Bruno, Swagger, Rest Assured. CI/CD & Dev Ops: Git Hub, Azure Dev Ops pipelines, release management. Performance tools awareness: JMeter, App Dynamics, Dynatrace, Data Dog, Cloud Watch. Soft Skills & Competencies Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead testing across multiple Foresight features. Excellent communication and stakeholder management. Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile and hybrid environments. Ability to analyze complex issues, propose solutions, and drive continuous improvement. Considerations for Top Candidates Hands-on experience with web based application automation Advanced debugging and troubleshooting skills for web based test automation. Experience building automated test scripts using Playwright Skilled in environment troubleshooting, regression cycles, and upgrade readiness validation. Ability to prepare clear test design documents, reusable QA templates, and developer guides for team adoption. Strong knowledge of batch job validation, workflow automation, and performance tuning. Experience with data migration testing using DMF/Data Management Framework and validation of large transactional datasets. Proficiency in API testing (OData, REST/SOAP, AIF/DMF). Exposure to CI/CD pipelines in Azure Dev Ops for automated regression cycles and release validation. Ability to conduct peer reviews of test automation scripts, enforce coding standards, and ensure compliance with Microsoft best practices. Skilled in preparing dashboards and test coverage reports for stakeholders, highlighting automation ROI and defect density. Familiarity with upgrade readiness testing, hotfix validation, and ensuring compatibility of customizations during cumulative updates. Experience 4
- 7+ years of QA experience with at least 3+ years in an automation-focused role. Proven experience in enterprise-scale web applications, including cloud platforms and multi-app ecosystems. This position requires working onsite five days a week. Relocation is available for this position. Posting Dates: September 7, 2026

Systems Integration Engineer Role Summary As a Systems Integration Engineer, you will be the technical bridge between machine electronics hardware, embedded software, and application-level features across Caterpillar's off-highway and tracked-machine product lines. You will own the end-to-end integration of Cat ECMs, Displays, and third-party components into a coherent machine electronics architecture — from requirements and architecture definition through HIL/SIL validation, factory support, and field issue resolution. You will work closely with Product Group stakeholders, global cross-functional engineering teams (electrical, mechanical, software), and factory/field teams to deliver reliable, high-quality machine systems on schedule. Key Responsibilities
1. System Architecture & Requirements Perform Cat architecture studies and develop control system architecture integrating Displays and Cat ECMs. Author technical specifications and system/software requirements for machine application features, including new features, enhancements, and CPIs. Establish integration strategy defining communication protocols (CAN/J1939, Ethernet/TCP-IP, etc.) between ECMs and Display systems. Define and document supporting requirements — interfaces, calibration parameters, boundary diagrams — and drive standard application components for system coherence.
2. Electrical & Software Design Support Support electrical schematic design activities, including ECM pinout design and component selection (sensors, switches, relays) in coordination with the electrical install team. Define software requirements for diagnostics, display, and engine/machine application software teams. Contribute to load studies and starting/charging analysis (battery, starter, alternator selection) where applicable.
3. Integration, Validation & Quality Lead machine electronics system integration and validation, including HIL/SIL bench testing, test plan authoring, and root-cause review of test failures. Integrate Display systems with Cat ECMs and third-party systems; conduct thorough system testing to confirm functionality, reliability, and safety standards. Participate in Built-In-Quality (BIQ) reviews, FMEAs, and Design Verification Plans (DVPs); ensure quality standards are met across the development lifecycle.
4. Factory & Field Support Provide in-person or remote build support for pilot and production machines; advise factory teams on end-of-line test stand design and software flashing setup. Analyze field/telemetry data (e.g., product health data) to determine root cause of field issues and support difficult field escalations via phone/Teams/email. Support machine commissioning, ensuring successful on-site integration of ECM and Display systems.
5. Technology Integration & Obsolescence Support technology integration programs such as Payload, Cycle Segmentation, Operator Assist, Collision Mitigation, Connectivity, and similar features — from requirements through proof-of-concept. Proactively manage obsolescence of electronics components; work with internal component teams and suppliers to identify and validate replacements.
6. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with electrical, mechanical, and software engineering teams to ensure seamless multi-disciplinary integration. Collaborate with project managers and Product Group stakeholders to meet program timelines, budgets, and quality targets. Document system architecture, programming logic, wiring diagrams, and release notes to support maintenance and future upgrades. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Instrumentation, or a related Engineering discipline. 8 – 12 years of relevant engineering experience in electronics/controls system design, integration, or validation for automotive, off-highway, or industrial machine products (experience range depends on target level — Engineer vs. Senior Engineer). Strong foundation in E&E components (sensors, switches, relays, ECMs) and control systems fundamentals. Working knowledge of datalink protocols such as CAN/J1939 and Ethernet TCP/IP. Ability to write clear, unambiguous technical specifications and requirements documents. Good understanding of diagnostics and troubleshooting methodology for control system failures. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills — this role requires constant interaction with regional and global development teams. Preferred / Top Candidate Qualifications Hands-on experience with HIL/SIL validation tools (e.g., Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape, d SPACE, MATLAB/Simulink). Familiarity with version control and workflow tools such as GIT/SVN and Azure Dev Ops. Exposure to AUTOSAR architecture and model-based development practices. Machine-level design and product application knowledge; familiarity with Caterpillar design/Teamcenter release processes and BIQ practices. Project leadership experience, Agile/Scrum exposure, and prior involvement in factory or field support activities. Six Sigma methodology or structured problem-solving experience (e.g., 8D, FMEA). What Success Looks Like Machine electronics architectures that are robust, standardized, and reusable across product variants. On-time delivery of validated software/system features that meet specification with minimal field escapes. Strong, trusted working relationships with Product Group, factory, and global engineering counterparts. Proactive identification and mitigation of obsolescence and integration risks well ahead of production impact. Posting Dates: September 7, 2026

title: Senior Software Engineer- Dynamics 365 (D365) F&O
jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Summary Caterpillar is seeking a candidate with strong expertise in X++ development, D365 F&O technical architecture, and integration strategies. The successful candidate will confidently engage in technical discussions, implementation strategies and D365 F&O template creations, ensuring seamless implementation, integrations and optimized performance, while mentoring engineers and guiding teams toward delivery excellence. This role includes the design, development, and support of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) solutions. You will be involved in core development work, SSRS, Power BI & MS Fabric report building, platform upgrades, and supporting code deployments across multiple environments. What You Will Do Technical Delivery & Development Deliver Dynamics 365 F&O implementations, upgrades, integrations, and customizations. Own and drive X++ development, customizations, and extensions using best practices. Perform customization and extension development using X++, Visual Studio, and the D365 Extension framework. Ensure adherence to Microsoft D365 standards, extensibility framework, and upgrade‑safe customizations. Review and optimize code for performance, scalability, and compliance with technical guidelines. Integration Engineering Design and implement integrations with third‑party systems using: OData REST / SOAP APIs AIF / DMF Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory Dual Write Microsoft Fabric Collaborate with functional consultants and project teams to align integration solutions with business needs. Data Management, Security & Performance Support data migration strategies and execution using DMF / Data Management Framework, acting as the primary technical SPOC. Configure and manage security roles & privileges, workflows, batch jobs, and performance tuning. Review technical designs, code, and deployment strategies to ensure compliance with best practices and security standards. Technical Assets & Automation Develop reusable templates, frameworks, and accelerators to standardize solution delivery. Drive automation initiatives using Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and AI‑driven workflows. Prepare TDD based on the FDD and requirements. Prepare python code to perform testing automations. Develop Technical Design Documents (TDDs) based on Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and business requirements, ensuring clarity and alignment between functional needs and technical solutions. Build and maintain Python scripts to automate testing processes, improving efficiency, accuracy, and repeatability across development and deployment cycles Dev Ops & Environment Management Apply strong knowledge of Dev Ops pipelines, CI/CD, D365 templates, and environment management for F&O projects. Manage build, release, and deployment activities across environments. Oversee version control and branching strategies to ensure upgrade‑safe delivery. Manage version control and code merges using Git Hub repositories, ensuring proper branching strategies, conflict resolution, and upgrade‑safe delivery across environments. Collaboration & Communication Confidently engage in technical discussions, implementation strategies, and template creation. Provide technical guidance to peers and junior developers to ensure delivery excellence. Participate in workshops, demos, and discussions with finance, supply chain, IT, and dealer stakeholders. Continuous Learning & Improvement Stay current with Microsoft technologies, Azure services, and industry trends to inform technical decisions. Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, Dev Ops, and solution governance. What You Will Have Technical Expertise Deep hands‑on experience with Dynamics 365 F&O modules (Finance, Supply Chain, Project Operations). Expert‑level knowledge of X++ development, SSRS reporting, and D365 F&O layered architecture. Strong understanding of customization, configuration, and upgrade‑safe extensions. Skilled in performance tuning, workflows, batch jobs, and security role configuration. Tools & Frameworks Proficiency in Visual Studio, D365 Extension framework, and developer workbench tools. Skilled in integration strategies using OData, REST/SOAP APIs, AIF/DMF, and Azure services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory). Experience with Common Data Services (Dual Write) for integration with Dynamics 365 Sales, Field Service, and Project Operations. Knowledge of SQL Server Management Studio, DMF tools, and ETL techniques for data migration. Hands‑on experience with Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and AI‑driven workflows for automation. Dev Ops & Environment Management Expertise in Azure Dev Ops: Git, pipelines, CI/CD, release management, and test plans. Skilled in environment management, version control (GITHUB), and branching strategies. Experience managing build, release, and deployment activities across Dev/UAT/Prod environments. Familiarity with Lifecycle Services (LCS) and Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC). Considerations for Top Candidates Advanced Debugging Skills – Ability to troubleshoot complex X++ code issues, identify root causes, and implement optimized fixes without impacting upgrade safety. Database Proficiency – Strong knowledge of SQL Server, indexing strategies, query optimization, and handling large transactional datasets within D365 F&O. Testing Automation – Experience building automated test scripts (e.g., using Python or other frameworks) to validate customizations, integrations, and performance benchmarks. API Development & Management – Skilled in designing custom APIs, managing authentication/authorization flows, and ensuring secure data exchange between F&O and external systems. Performance Engineering – Hands‑on expertise in profiling system performance, tuning batch jobs, and optimizing heavy workloads in production environments. Upgrade & Hotfix Readiness – Ability to assess Microsoft cumulative updates, apply hotfixes, and validate compatibility of customizations during platform upgrades. Cross‑Module Technical Depth – Practical exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, and Project Operations with the ability to extend functionality across multiple modules. Code Review & Quality Assurance – Experience conducting peer reviews, enforcing coding standards, and ensuring compliance with Microsoft best practices. Environment Troubleshooting – Skilled in diagnosing environment issues (Dev/UAT/Prod), resolving deployment failures, and managing dependencies across builds. Documentation & Knowledge Sharing – Ability to prepare clear technical design documents (TDDs), integration specifications, and reusable developer guides for team adoption. Integration & Reporting Proficiency – Demonstrated expertise in leveraging Microsoft Fabric and other middleware platforms to design scalable integration pipelines, enable real‑time data exchange, and deliver advanced reporting solutions across Dynamics 365 CE Sales and Field Service. Test Automation Expertise – Extensive experience with modern testing frameworks and tools for Dynamics 365 F&O applications. Preferred exposure to Leapwork, Azure App Testing, Playwright, with accepted proficiency in JMeter, Ranorex, Selenium, or equivalent platforms to validate customizations, integrations, and performance across Finance, Supply Chain, Retail & Commerce & Project Operations modules. Experience 8–10+ years of demonstrated work experience in ERP technologies with 6+ years in Dynamics 365 F&O/AX technical development. Proven experience as a Technical Developer in at least 5 full‑cycle D365 F&O implementations. Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and manage technical delivery. Certifications (Preferred) MB‑500: Finance & Operations Apps Developer Experience with Power Pages (portals) or AI‑powered Copilot Studio Posting Dates: September 6, 2026

What you will have Preferred previous consultancy experience (1-2 years)/overall experience 2-5 years Strong digital acumen and Knowledge of project management methodologies Ability to use sound problem solving skills and tactics when identifying and defining problems, selecting solutions, and reducing performance gaps Ability to work effectively across a matrix environment and navigate without a formal authority to deliver on business results Accounting certification or an equivalent combination of related experience Additional Information: This position requires the selected candidate to work Full -Time in the Whitefield Bangalore, Karnataka office. Level Working Knowledge: •Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient. •Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness. •Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work. •Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate. •Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups. Level Basic Understanding: •Explains basic concepts of time and priority management. •Seeks guidance in detecting and addressing priority conflicts. •States own business priorities. •Describes team or unit priorities. Level Working Knowledge: •Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives. •Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder. •Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information. •Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution. •Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems. Level Working Knowledge: •Utilizes cost monitoring practices, techniques and considerations. •Works with financial transactions and related documentation within the organization. •Participates in accounting practices of classifying and recording financial data. •Maintains existing charts of accounts. •Follows regulations for entering and reporting the financial content in major accounting systems. Financial Reporting: Knowledge of processes, methods, and tools of financial reporting; ability to create and maintain accurate and thorough financial reports. Level Basic Understanding: •Describes basic methods for financial report writing. •Identifies basic financial report-writing tools. •Clarifies the purpose and value of accurate financial reports. •Utilizes the major financial reports used by the organization. What you will get: Work Life Harmony Earned and medical leave. title: Oil & Gas Major Accounts Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description: Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Role Purpose The Account Manager is responsible for driving long-term business growth by building strong relationships with customers, dealers, and key stakeholders in the Oil & Gas industry. The role focuses on identifying future opportunities, acting as a trusted advisor to customers, and collaborating closely with the Territory Manager to support and expand the business. Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Growth Identify, evaluate, and develop new business opportunities within the assigned territory. Focus on long-term revenue generation and strategic account development. Drive pipeline creation and ensure sustainable business growth.
2. Customer Relationship Management Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and decision-makers. Act as a trusted consultant/advisor, understanding customer needs and providing tailored solutions. Identify customer challenges and proactively offer value-driven recommendations.
3. Dealer Engagement Establish and nurture strong relationships with dealer personnel. Work closely with dealers to align on sales strategies and customer engagement plans. Support dealer teams in identifying and pursuing business opportunities.
4. Collaboration with Territory Manager Work in close partnership with the Territory Manager, who owns overall business delivery. Provide insights on market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape. Support execution of territory plans and revenue targets.
5. Market Intelligence & Strategy Gather and analyze market insights, customer feedback, and competitor activity. Identify emerging trends and translate them into actionable opportunities. Contribute to strategic planning and go-to-market initiatives.
6. Travel & Field Engagement Travel approximately 50% of the time to meet customers, dealers, and partners. Conduct regular field visits to strengthen relationships and identify growth opportunities. Scope of the Role Geographical Scope: India, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka Stakeholders: Territory Manager (primary internal partner) Logistics Finance Legal Dealer personnel End customers and key accounts Focus Areas: Long-term business development Relationship building and customer consulting Opportunity identification and pipeline growth Decision Influence: Influences customer strategy and opportunity prioritization Supports business decisions through market insights Key Attributes & Competencies Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills Consultative, customer-centric approach Strategic thinker with focus on long-term opportunities Effective communicator with influencing ability Collaborative team player (works closely with Territory Manager & dealers) Proactive, self-driven, and results-oriented Adaptable with willingness to travel (~50%) Experience working with State-Owned Oil Companies and have also built relationships and worked closely with mid-senior management within ONGC and OIL highly preferred.
